## Learning Objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Understand window functions vs. aggregate functions
- Use ranking functions (rank, row_number, dense_rank)
- Calculate running totals and moving averages
- Apply analytical functions (lag, lead, first_value, last_value)

This chapter covers advanced analytical functions using window operations in Ibis,
which compute values across a set of rows related to the current row while preserving
the original table structure.

## What Are Window Functions?

Window functions compute values across a set of rows related to the current row,
unlike aggregate functions which collapse rows into groups:
